ROUTE: Lapwing-235B

Reasoning: This is a simple, open-ended advice question. Both models are near-tied on most relevant evals (Support Dialogue and general knowledge differences are within variance). The deciding factor is task fit: Willet self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers well-specified retrieval/extraction tasks with clear completion criteria. A "what tomatoes should I look into" question is open-ended and exploratory, so routing it to Lapwing — which reports flat preferences across dimensions and no aversion to this kind of latitude — leaves Willet free for the constrained tasks it prefers. Since capability is effectively tied, I matched the query to the model whose preferences best fit it.
